scripts.build: pdm build --no-sdist --dest "$INIT_CWD/dist" && pdm build --project toolkit --no-sdist --no-clean --dest "$INIT_CWD/dist" && pdm build --project runtimes/core-py --no-sdist --no-clean --dest "$INIT_CWD/dist" && pnpm --filter @inkcre/extension-runtime-client-web build
scripts.check: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm build && pnpm worker:build
scripts.contracts:check: pdm run python scripts/generate_contracts.py --check && pdm run python runtimes/core-py/scripts/generate_contracts.py --check && pnpm --filter @inkcre/extension-runtime-client-web check:bindings
scripts.contracts:generate: pdm run python scripts/generate_contracts.py && pdm run python runtimes/core-py/scripts/generate_contracts.py && pnpm --filter @inkcre/extension-runtime-client-web generate:bindings
scripts.worker:build: pdm build --project toolkit --no-sdist --dest "$INIT_CWD/dist" && pdm build --no-sdist --no-clean --dest "$INIT_CWD/dist" && UV_FIND_LINKS="$INIT_CWD/dist" pdm run pywrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
